scripts.dev: bun run build:client && bun run src/server/index.ts
scripts.build:client: bun build src/client/main.ts --outfile src/client/main.js --target browser && bun build src/client/analytics.ts --outfile src/client/analytics.js --target browser
scripts.build: bun build src/client/main.ts --outfile src/client/main.js --target browser --minify && bun build src/client/analytics.ts --outfile src/client/analytics.js --target browser --minify
